title: Access and account
subtitle: Tasklet, a fictional to-do app for small teams. Persona Ana Lima (Northwind Bakery) signs up, signs in with Lumen ID (a fictional identity provider), and fails a sign-in. Static demo pages, captured with Playwright.

lanes.title: Create an account with e-mail
lanes.desc: Work e-mail and password (at least 8 characters). Tasklet sends a confirmation link; the link opens the team space.

lanes.title: Sign in with Lumen ID
lanes.desc: "Continue with Lumen ID" opens the provider's account chooser. Choosing the account returns to the team space.

steps.title: Choose an account
steps.desc: Says "to continue to auth.tasklet-infra.example", not Tasklet.

steps.title: Consent
steps.note: A real provider account is needed past this point; not capturable.

lanes.title: Sign in and get the password wrong
lanes.desc: E-mail and password. A wrong password shows a generic error that does not say which field is wrong.

lanes.title: Variation: reset a forgotten password
lanes.desc: The sign-in page offers "Forgot password?". The link leads nowhere.

notes.title: Loose ends in this area
notes.body:
• Lumen ID shows the infrastructure domain auth.tasklet-infra.example instead of the app name (configure the provider's app name and a branded auth domain).
• "Forgot password?" leads to a 404: there is no way to recover an account.
